Anna (CS): Quick sync for Quillix dedicated bring-up. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a short load-test window. Finance has a billing hold until we provide a perf summary. Can we land this by EOD?
Sam (Infra): @Anna what steady RPS and p95 should infra tune for?
Miguel (PM): SLA = 200 rps steady, bursts to 900 for up to 10m. p95 target <= 220ms in us-west. Cold-start behavior is a redline for them.
Priya (Oncall): I can run smoke + soak during 2026-06-02 14:00-16:00 UTC. Which ded pool are we assigning?
Sam (Infra): Using ded-pool-g6 (48G). Recs: batch_size=32 for short sequences. Autoscale proposal: scale_up at 60% GPU util or 180 rps, scale_down after 5m idle, min_instances=2, max_instances=20.
Anna (CS): Action list: 1) Sam publish autoscale policy, 2) Priya run load scripts, 3) Miguel confirm load profile, 4) I'll prepare perf report for billing.
Miguel (PM): I'll extract traffic traces and produce a 3-min burst profile. Also prepare canary shift plan in case of thermal limits.
Sam (Infra): Canary plan: 5% shadow to dedicated for 30m, then 25% for 20m before full cutover. Rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 300ms.
Priya (Oncall): Reserve noted. I'll add oncall coverage. Dry-run in staging tomorrow at 50% load.
capacity-bot: slot reserved: ded-pool-g6 @2026-06-02 14:00-16:00 UTC by Priya. Reservation ID: RB-8812.
Sam (Infra): Load test command for reference:
```
locust -f tests/quillix_sim.py --headless -u 900 -r 100 --run-time 20m --host https://api.redwood.example
```
And prime KV: `scripts/prime_kv.sh --model quillix-v1 --clients 50`.
Miguel (PM): Test data checklist: token median 1024, 10% tool-calls, 2% rerank. I'll drop dataset in /shared/quillix/testset-v2 by 2026-06-01 18:00 UTC.
Priya (Oncall): Autoscale policy snippet (Sam please formalize):
```
policy: { "scale_up": {"gpu_util_pct": 60, "min_delta_instances": 1}, "scale_down": {"idle_minutes": 5}, "max_instances": 20, "min_instances": 2 }
```
Sam (Infra): I'll push infra PR. ETA ~3h.
Anna (CS): For feedback capture I'll send a 5-question survey post-test: perf ok? regressions? warm starts? cost impact? autoscale ease? Drop qualitative notes here.
Miguel (PM): Add client-side timeout tests and verify fallback routing to hosted models if dedicated saturates.
Priya (Oncall): I'll post staging dry-run logs here after tomorrow's test.
Sam (Infra): Heads-up: thermal sensor alert at 85C may cap bursts. I'll add monitoring.
capacity-bot: monitoring alert rule created: gpu-temp-high -> #eng-oncall. Threshold 82C.
Anna (CS): If numbers look marginal we'll run a 30-min incident playbook with Quillix. Otherwise deliver report and proceed to renewal checkpoint.
Anna (CS): Thanks all — will share perf report template before EOD. :thumbsup:
